method: Parent read all draft subjects and final replacements; author read124 sources; independent peer read set and spot-checked10 fragile claims. Parent improved15 choice sets or wordings following review and removed stopped-clock restatement.
duplicateReview: Full q+a+d author and parent screens; peer topic reading. Removed lens-protein dating, roller-coaster kidney and banana-friction variations before import. Final combined screen found no further definite duplicates.

rejection.reason: Stopped-clock prompt gives the apparent stretched interval and asks for the same information. The phenomenon is valid; this question is not useful enough.
